Answer A (DASH Plus Sodium Default): Follow the DASH diet with strict sodium reduction below 2,300 mg/day — the combination produces the largest evidence-based BP reduction (8–14 mmHg) equivalent to a medication dose.

Answer B (Sodium Reduction First): Focus solely on reducing sodium intake as the single most impactful dietary lever — it's easier to track than the full DASH diet and produces 5–6 mmHg reduction with less lifestyle overhaul.
